<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="es">

<head>

<meta charset="UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<meta name="color-scheme" content="light only">

<title>Livny Fuentes · Marketing Digital, Lanzamientos & Contenido</title>

<meta name="description" content="Portafolio de Livny Fuentes. Marketing digital, lanzamientos, crecimiento orgánico y creación de contenido. +50K en TikTok, campañas de millones de views con $0 en ads.">


<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;0,800;1,700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">


<style>

:root{

  --dark:#0A0A0A;

  --wine:#3A0A0F;

  --cherry:#D6112E;

  --gold:#D4A843;

  --cream:#FFF7EE;

  --cream2:#F5EDE3;

  --gray:#999;

  --light-gray:#ccc;

}

*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}

html{scroll-behavior:smooth;background:var(--dark)}

body{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--cream);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}

a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

img{display:block;max-width:100%}


/* ANIMATIONS */

.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}

.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}

.reveal-delay{transition-delay:.2s}


/* NAV */

nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;padding:18px 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(10,10,10,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}

.nav-logo{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em}

.nav-logo span{color:var(--cherry)}

.nav-links{display:flex;gap:24px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}

.nav-links a{opacity:.6;transition:opacity .2s}

.nav-links a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--cherry)}

.nav-cta{background:var(--cherry);color:#fff;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:99px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;transition:background .2s,transform .2s}

.nav-cta:hover{background:#B00E28;transform:scale(1.04)}

@media(max-width:768px){.nav-links{display:none}.nav-cta{font-size:12px;padding:8px 16px}}


/* HERO */

.hero{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;align-items:center;gap:40px;padding:120px 48px 80px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-20%;right:-10%;width:600px;height:600px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(214,17,46,.12),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}

.hero-text .kicker{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cherry);margin-bottom:20px;display:inline-block}

.hero-text h1{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,84px);line-height:.95;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:24px}

.hero-text h1 .outline{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--cream)}

.hero-text h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cherry)}

.hero-sub{font-size:clamp(15px,1.8vw,18px);color:var(--gray);max-width:520px;margin-bottom:32px;line-height:1.7}

.hero-sub strong{color:var(--cream)}

.hero-stats{display:flex;gap:32px;margin-bottom:36px}

.stat-item .stat-n{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold)}

.stat-item .stat-l{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-top:2px}

.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.btn-primary{background:var(--cherry);color:#fff;padding:16px 32px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(214,17,46,.35);transition:all .2s}

.btn-primary:hover{background:#B00E28;transform:translateY(-2px)}

.btn-outline{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:var(--cream);padding:16px 32px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;transition:all .2s}

.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--cherry);color:var(--cherry)}

.hero-photo{position:relative}

.hero-photo img{border-radius:20px;max-height:600px;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;box-shadow:0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}

.hero-photo .float-tag{position:absolute;bottom:20px;left:20px;background:rgba(10,10,10,.8);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);padding:10px 18px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}

@media(max-width:900px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:110px 24px 60px;text-align:center}.hero-stats{justify-content:center}.hero-btns{justify-content:center}.hero-photo{max-width:360px;margin:0 auto}.hero-sub{margin:0 auto 32px}}


/* MARQUEE */

.marquee{padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}

.marquee-track{display:inline-flex;animation:scroll 30s linear infinite}

.marquee span{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 28px;color:var(--gray)}

.marquee span:nth-child(even){color:var(--gold)}

@keyframes scroll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}


/* SECTIONS */

.section{padding:100px 48px}

.section-dark{background:var(--dark)}

.section-wine{background:var(--wine)}

.section-cream{background:var(--cream);color:var(--dark)}

.section-cream .section-kicker{color:var(--cherry)}

.section-cream .gray{color:#666}

.section-cream .card-dark{background:var(--dark);color:var(--cream);border:none}

.section-inner{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto}

.section-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:16px}

.section-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,52px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:16px;max-width:700px}

.section-title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cherry)}

.section-lead{font-size:17px;color:var(--gray);max-width:600px;margin-bottom:48px;line-height:1.7}

.section-cream .section-lead{color:#666}

@media(max-width:768px){.section{padding:64px 24px}}


/* STORY */

.story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:start}

.story-grid p{font-size:15px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.7}

.story-grid p strong{color:var(--cream)}

.story-quote{background:var(--wine);border-radius:20px;padding:36px 30px}

.story-quote p{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2.6vw,28px);font-style:italic;color:var(--cream);line-height:1.4;margin:0}

.story-quote p span{color:var(--gold)}

.story-photo{margin-top:24px}

.story-photo img{border-radius:16px;width:100%;max-height:420px;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}

@media(max-width:768px){.story-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


/* CASE STUDIES */

.case{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:24px;padding:44px 40px;margin-bottom:32px;transition:border-color .3s}

.case:hover{border-color:var(--cherry)}

.case-kicker{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cherry);margin-bottom:14px}

.case h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,32px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:12px}

.case p{font-size:15px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:20px;max-width:640px;line-height:1.7}

.case-stats{display:flex;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}

.case-stat{background:rgba(212,168,67,.08);border:1px solid rgba(212,168,67,.2);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;min-width:140px}

.case-stat .cs-n{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold)}

.case-stat .cs-l{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-top:4px}

.case-tags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--gray)}

@media(max-width:600px){.case{padding:28px 22px}}


/* EXPERIENCE COMPACT */

.exp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:16px}

.exp-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:18px;padding:26px 22px;transition:border-color .3s}

.exp-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}

.exp-card .exp-role{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px}

.exp-card h4{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}

.exp-card p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.6}


/* TOOLS */

.tools-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:12px}

.tool{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 14px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;transition:all .2s}

.tool:hover{border-color:var(--cherry);transform:translateY(-3px)}

.tool .tool-icon{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px}


/* SERVICES */

.services-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:18px}

.service{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:22px;padding:34px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:all .3s}

.service:hover{border-color:var(--cherry);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(214,17,46,.12)}

.service .srv-num{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--cherry);margin-bottom:16px}

.service h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:12px}

.service p{font-size:14px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.6;flex:1;margin-bottom:24px}

.srv-btn{display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--cherry);color:#fff;padding:14px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;transition:background .2s}

.srv-btn:hover{background:#B00E28}


/* PROMPT GIFT */

.gift-banner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cherry) 0%,#8A0E1E 100%);border-radius:26px;padding:52px 44px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;box-shadow:0 28px 64px rgba(214,17,46,.30)}

.gift-banner h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,38px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:16px;color:#fff}

.gift-banner h3 span{color:var(--gold)}

.gift-banner p{font-size:15px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);margin-bottom:24px;max-width:460px}

.gift-banner .btn-white{background:#fff;color:var(--cherry);padding:16px 30px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;display:inline-block;transition:all .2s;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}

.gift-banner .btn-white:hover{background:var(--gold);color:var(--dark)}

.gift-note{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-top:12px}

.fake-chat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}

.msg{padding:14px 18px;border-radius:18px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;max-width:85%}

.msg.user{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);color:var(--dark);align-self:flex-end;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}

.msg.bot{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;align-self:flex-start;border-bottom-left-radius:4px}

.msg.doc{background:rgba(212,168,67,.2);border:1px dashed var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}

@media(max-width:820px){.gift-banner{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:36px 26px}}


/* RECS */

.recs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px}

.rec{border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:20px;padding:28px 24px;text-align:center;transition:all .3s}

.rec .rec-tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cherry);margin-bottom:14px}

.rec h4{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}

.rec p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:18px}

.rec .soon{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray);border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.15);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:99px;display:inline-block}

.recs-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:24px;max-width:600px}


/* TESTIMONIALS */

.testi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:18px}

.t-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:20px;padding:30px 26px}

.t-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:14px}

.t-card p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:18px;line-height:1.6}

.t-card p strong{color:var(--cream)}

.t-who{font-size:14px;font-weight:700}.t-role{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray)}


/* CONTACT */

.contact{text-align:center;padding:100px 48px 60px}

.contact .section-title{margin:0 auto 16px}

.contact .section-lead{margin:0 auto 40px}

.socials{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:24px;margin-top:32px}

.socials a{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;opacity:.6;transition:opacity .2s;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}

.socials a:hover{opacity:1;border-color:var(--cherry)}


/* FOOTER */

footer{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding:28px 48px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--gray)}


/* GALLERY */

.gallery-scroll{overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;display:flex;gap:14px;padding:12px 0}

.gallery-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}

.gallery-scroll .phone{min-width:180px;max-width:180px;flex-shrink:0;scroll-snap-align:start}

.gallery-nav{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}

.gallery-nav button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:var(--cream);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}

.gallery-nav button:hover{background:var(--cherry);border-color:var(--cherry)}


/* CAROUSEL */

.carousel{position:relative;margin-top:40px}

.carousel-track{display:flex;gap:18px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;padding-bottom:8px}

.carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}

.carousel-track .exp-card{min-width:290px;max-width:320px;flex-shrink:0;scroll-snap-align:start}

.carousel-nav{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}

.carousel-nav button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:var(--cream);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}

.carousel-nav button:hover{background:var(--cherry);border-color:var(--cherry)}


/* PHONE MOCKUP */

.phone{

  position:relative;display:inline-block;

  background:#1a1a1a;border-radius:28px;padding:10px;

  box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 0 0 2px #333;

  transition:transform .4s ease;

}

.phone:hover{transform:scale(1.02)}

.phone::before{

  content:"";position:absolute;top:10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);

  width:60px;height:6px;background:#333;border-radius:99px;z-index:2;

}

.phone img{border-radius:20px;display:block;width:100%}

.phones-row{display:flex;gap:24px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:32px}

.phones-row .phone{max-width:220px;flex-shrink:0}

@media(max-width:600px){.phones-row .phone{max-width:160px}}


/* ANIMATED CTA */

.btn-pulse{animation:btnPulse 2.4s ease infinite}

@keyframes btnPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(214,17,46,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(214,17,46,0)}}

.srv-btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.srv-btn::after{

  content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:50%;

  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .5s,height .5s;

}

.srv-btn:hover::after{width:300px;height:300px}


/* EVIDENCE GRID */

.evidence{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:28px}

.evidence img{border-radius:12px;width:100%;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:transform .3s}

.evidence img:hover{transform:scale(1.03)}

.evidence-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;max-width:500px}

.evidence-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}

.ev-caption{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);text-align:center;margin-top:6px}

.before-after{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin-top:28px;max-width:560px}

.before-after img{border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}

.ba-arrow{font-size:32px;color:var(--gold)}

.social-proof-row{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-top:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.social-proof-row img{border-radius:12px;max-height:360px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}

@media(max-width:600px){.evidence{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.evidence-3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.before-after{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center}.social-proof-row{flex-direction:column}.social-proof-row img{max-height:300px}}


/* REDUCED MOTION */

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}

</style>

</head>

<body>


<!-- NAV -->

<nav>

  <div class="nav-logo">LIVNY<span>.</span></div>

  <div class="nav-links">

    <a href="#historia">Historia</a>

    <a href="#casos" style="color:var(--cherry)">Portafolio</a>

    <a href="#habilidades">Habilidades</a>

    <a href="#servicios">Servicios</a>

    <a href="#contacto">Contacto</a>

  </div>

  <a class="nav-cta" href="#servicios">Trabajemos juntos</a>

</nav>


<!-- HERO -->

<header class="hero">

  <div class="hero-text">

    <span class="kicker">Portafolio</span>

    <h1>Especialista en <em>lanzamientos,</em> creación de contenido y ventas por redes sociales</h1>

    <p class="hero-sub">Conecto tu marca con la audiencia correcta. La que sí compra.</p>


    <div class="hero-btns">

      <a class="btn-primary btn-pulse" href="#servicios">Trabajemos juntos →</a>

      <a class="btn-outline" href="#casos">Ver mi trabajo</a>

    </div>

  </div>

<section class="section section-dark" id="historia">

  <div class="section-inner">

    <span class="section-kicker reveal">Mi historia</span>

    <div class="section-title reveal"><em>Empecé</em> entregando jeans puerta a puerta.</div>

    <div class="story-grid">

      <div class="reveal">

        <p>Mi primera empresa fue <strong>Ailiv</strong>, una tienda de ropa donde lo hacía absolutamente todo: viajaba a Santiago a comprar cada prenda, fotografiaba, publicaba, vendía — y entregaba los pedidos a domicilio, una por una.</p>

        <p>Durante la pandemia, cuando nadie podía salir de su casa, <strong>yo iba con permiso sanitario a llevarles la ropa para que se la probaran</strong>. Ese concepto — "te llevo los jeans a tu casa, te los pruebas y si te gustan te los quedas" — fue mi primer sistema de ventas.</p>

        <p>Después vinieron los festivales holísticos que produje sola en el Valle del Elqui y la Araucanía, las campañas orgánicas de millones de views, los lanzamientos digitales, las marcas internacionales. Hoy estudio <strong>Psicología</strong> porque entendí que mi ventaja siempre fue la misma: <strong>entender a las personas detrás de las métricas.</strong></p>

      </div>

      <div class="reveal reveal-delay">

        <div class="story-quote">

          <p>"No veo métricas. Veo <span>personas</span> que deciden confiar en una marca."</p>

        </div>

      <h3 style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,30px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--cream)">Ailiv — <em style="color:var(--cherry)">Llevamos la tienda a tu casa</em></h3>

      <p style="font-size:15px;color:var(--gray);max-width:580px;margin-bottom:20px">Mi tienda de ropa donde hacía todo: compras a proveedores, fotos, contenido, ventas, packaging personalizado y entregas puerta a puerta. Durante la pandemia, iba con permiso sanitario a las casas de las clientas para que se probaran la ropa antes de comprar.</p>

      <h3>IN SOUL — Festivales holísticos en la naturaleza</h3>

      <p>Producción integral de 2 festivales: Valle del Elqui y Araucanía. Coordinación de todo el equipo (terapeutas, DJs, voluntarios, cocina), venta de tickets, comunicación de marca y contenido. Promoción 100% orgánica con videos virales.</p>
